title: Standing desks and the sitting panic

turns.speaker: Nell
turns.text: Everyone got a standing desk in the refit and about three people still use them.

turns.speaker: Tobias
turns.text: That's the finding everywhere. Enthusiasm lasts about six weeks.

turns.speaker: Rhian
turns.text: Sitting is the new smoking was always a ridiculous line, mind you. It compared a behaviour to something that kills half its users.

turns.speaker: Nell
turns.text: But the studies did find something, didn't they?

turns.speaker: Rhian
turns.text: They found that prolonged sitting is associated with worse outcomes, and then most of the effect turned out to be explained by total activity.

turns.speaker: Tobias
turns.text: Meaning if you exercise enough, the sitting matters much less.

turns.speaker: Rhian
turns.text: Substantially less. The people at genuine risk were sedentary all day and also inactive outside work.

turns.speaker: Nell
turns.text: So a standing desk doesn't fix much because standing still isn't activity either.

turns.speaker: Tobias
turns.text: It's barely more energy than sitting, and it has its own problems. Varicose veins, back pain if you stand badly.

turns.speaker: Rhian
turns.text: What does show up is breaking it up. Getting up every half hour beats either posture held for eight hours.

turns.speaker: Nell
turns.text: Which is free and requires no furniture.

turns.speaker: Tobias
turns.text: And is therefore much harder to sell to a facilities budget.

turns.speaker: Rhian
turns.text: That's most of workplace wellbeing in one observation.

points: Standing desks installed in an office are largely unused after a few weeks, which is the general pattern.
Rhian rejects the comparison between sitting and smoking as disproportionate.
Research associating prolonged sitting with worse outcomes was largely explained by total physical activity.
People at genuine risk were sedentary at work and inactive outside it.
Standing consumes barely more energy than sitting and carries its own problems such as varicose veins and back pain.
The effective intervention is breaking up sitting every half hour, which is free and therefore harder to justify as a purchase.
